posts.title: The Tadpole SPARCbook 6500
posts.description: I bought a SPARC laptop at a garage sale. The machine is a Tadpole SPARCbook 6500 with an UltraSPARC-IIe at 650 MHz, 4GB of RAM, and a 1400x1050 panel. Tadpole built these in Carlsbad after merging with RDI, and they are the last generation of a genuinely strange idea: a laptop that runs Solaris on real SPARC silicon. It powers on. It also greets you with this: The IDPROM contents are invalid Dead

posts.title: She was critically ill.
posts.description: On March 19th, I watched a helicopter take off. On that helicopter was my mom. posts.title: Welcome back and Calling friends from space!
posts.description: “Welcome back” is what I hear as Daniel and I walk into the tiny Chinese restaurant that is 30 minutes North of our house, but serves amazing tofu. We come to this one because it’s in the best location, next to the lake and we can just sit and listen to the waves against the rock wall. It’s a sleepy town in the winter that’s internationally recognized for its racing prowess and its beautiful gorge
